evidence.reason: Line 113 scans PR-controlled commit messages with `gitleaks stdin` but does not pass `--ignore-gitleaks-allow`; the same omission appears on the two `gitleaks git` calls at lines 102 and 105. Gitleaks honors inline `gitleaks:allow` directives by default, so PR-controlled content can suppress a denylist finding, defeating the fail-closed denylist required by current contract item 17. Adding the flag to all scanner calls through the workflow template is a small compatible repair.
